definitions.A: point-rounds where a certificate was attempted
definitions.J: duplicate failed-point assignments redone by same-round global fallback
definitions.N: retained point-rounds over the complete requested trajectory
definitions.P: attempted certificate passes, including passes discarded by same-round fallback
definitions.S: point-round assignments usefully skipped after accounting for same-round fallback
definitions.rates: P/A attempted pass; P/N whole-trajectory certified fraction; S/N useful skips; assignments N-S+J
definitions.timing: elapsed: measured serial call; modeled: client critical path + server; end-to-end: call + input load + checkpoint load + survivor materialization + witness output; no network measurement
definitions.uncertainty: SE of arithmetic paired speedup mean; single-trial settings have no SE; aggregate dataset rows combine declared k levels and are not independent-population estimates
